title: Billing Record
description: Normalized billing and usage record accepted by the cloud cost optimization platform.

organizationId.description: Tenant identifier derived from the authenticated user or organization context.

usageDate.description: Date represented by the billing record in ISO 8601 format.

service.description: Cloud service name, such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, or EBS.

resourceId.description: Cloud resource identifier or billing line-item identifier.

resourceType.description: Normalized resource category, such as small-instance, large-instance, gpu-instance, or storage.

usageAmount.description: Usage quantity before currency conversion or billing calculation.

monthlyCost.description: Cost in the currency specified by currency.

utilizationPercent.description: Average utilization percentage for the record period.

tags.description: Optional resource tags used for additional grouping.
